_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Meilisearch egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: Meilisearch
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Meilisearch is a fast, typo-tolerant search engine with a simple HTTP API. Downloads the official release and keeps its database between updates.
startup: exec ./meilisearch --http-addr 0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}} --db-path data.ms --dump-dir dumps --snapshot-dir snapshots $([ "{{SERVER_MEMORY}}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && echo "--max-indexing-memory $(({{SERVER_MEMORY}} - {{SERVER_MEMORY}} / 3))MiB") $([ "{{NO_ANALYTICS}}" = 1 ] && echo --no-analytics)

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Meilisearch: downloads the meilisearch binary from its GitHub releases,
# checked against the release's SHA-256. The database (data.ms), dumps and
# config.toml are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=aarch64 ;;
    *) echo "Meilisearch has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))."; exit 1 ;;
esac

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
# gh-release says why when the release doesn't exist or GitHub can't be reached.
tag=$(gh-release tag meilisearch/meilisearch "$version") || exit 1
asset="meilisearch-linux-${arch}"

if [ -x meilisearch ] && [ "$(cat .meilisearch-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "Meilisearch $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Meilisearch $tag."
    gh-release download meilisearch/meilisearch "$tag" "$asset" meilisearch.new
    chmod 0755 meilisearch.new
    mv -f meilisearch.new meilisearch
    echo "$tag" > .meilisearch-version
fi
mkdir -p dumps snapshots
echo "Installed Meilisearch $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Meilisearch version to install, such as 1.56.2, or latest. Moving to a new minor version may need a dump and import of your data.

variables.name: Master key
variables.description: The key that protects the API, at least 16 characters. Required in production.

variables.name: Environment
variables.description: production requires a master key and hides the search preview; development is for testing.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: How much Meilisearch writes to the console.

variables.name: Indexing threads
variables.description: The most CPU threads indexing may use.

variables.name: Turn off analytics
variables.description: Stop sending anonymous usage data to Meilisearch.
